desc.zh: 你账户里的数字不是金库里的钞票。它是谁的欠条、怎样被贷款造出来、为什么银行会被挤兑、为什么每年能买的东西少一点。八个可以拖动的模型。
desc.en: The number in your bank account is not a pile of notes in a vault. Whose IOU it is, how loans create it, why banks can be run, and why it buys a little less each year, in eight models you can push around.

title.zh: 钱是一张人人都收的欠条
title.en: Money as an IOU everyone accepts

desc.zh: 物物交换要两个愿望同时对上；一张所有人都信得过的欠条把一笔交易拆成两半。
desc.en: Barter needs two wants to match at once; an IOU that everyone trusts splits a trade into two halves.

desc.zh: 银行放贷时同时写下一笔贷款和一笔新存款，还款时这笔存款消失。
desc.en: A bank loan writes a loan and a new deposit at the same moment; repaying it deletes the deposit.

desc.zh: 银行没亏钱，只要足够多的人同时来取也会倒；存款保险和最后贷款人拆掉了这个临界点。
desc.en: A solvent bank can still fail if enough people withdraw at once; deposit insurance and a lender of last resort remove the tipping point.

desc.zh: 长期看，钱和转手速度加起来比东西长得快，物价就涨；短期里多出来的钱先变成产出，供给冲击也能单独推高物价。
desc.en: In the long run prices rise when money and its velocity outgrow output; in the short run extra money first raises output, and supply shocks can raise prices on their own.

title.en: Who wins and loses from inflation

desc.zh: 意外的通胀把财富从储户搬到固定利率的借款人；预料之中的通胀已经写进了利率，不搬运财富。
desc.en: Surprise inflation moves wealth from savers to fixed-rate borrowers; inflation everyone expected is already in the interest rate and moves nothing.

title.en: Interest as the price of time

desc.zh: 名义利率约等于时间的价格加上预期通胀；按利率把未来的钱折回今天，就是现值。
desc.en: A nominal rate is roughly the price of time plus expected inflation; discounting future money at that rate gives its present value.

zh: 利率上升债券为什么跌
en: why bond prices fall when rates rise

desc.zh: 每月先付剩余本金的利息，剩下才减本金，所以前几年主要在付利息；多还的钱全部减本金。
desc.en: Each payment first covers interest on what is still owed and only the rest repays principal, so early payments are mostly interest; extra payments go straight to principal.

desc.zh: 央行利率经过市场利率、贷款利率和家庭预算，一到两三年后才落到物价上；浮动利率越多，传得越快越强。
desc.en: A central bank rate passes through market rates, loan rates and household budgets and reaches prices only after one to three years; more variable-rate debt makes it faster and stronger.

zh: 央行加息对房贷的影响
固定利率还是浮动利率
en: what does a rate hike do
how long until rate rises work
how do interest rates affect inflation

title.en: Purchasing power parity and exchange rates

desc.zh: 长期看通胀高的货币会贬值；短期里资金流动让汇率偏离平价，偏离减半要好几年。
desc.en: Over the long run a high-inflation currency depreciates; in the short run capital flows push the rate away from parity, and the gap takes years to halve.
